title: 2-Year Floating Rate Note auction (first reopening of the October new issue) — settles into the Thanksgiving early close
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) by the treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19 initial research, text layer decompressed stream-by-stream and re-tokenised into 213 rows. Row reads `2-Year FRN R / Announcement Thursday, November 19, 2026 / Auction Tuesday, November 24, 2026 / Settlement Friday, November 27, 2026` — the trailing `R` marks it a REOPENING, matching the 08-20 and 09-17 and 12-17 FRN rows in the same PDF and contrasting with the 10-22 row, which carries no `R` and is the quarterly new issue already tracked as treasury-2y-frn-2026-10-28. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-11-19 announcement itself. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09) and proposed because its proposer is the announcement that sizes it. WHAT IT IS, precisely: the FIRST of the two monthly reopenings of the quarterly FRN new issue that sells 2026-10-28 — the cycle runs new issue in the last week of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct, first reopening the following month, second reopening the month after, verified 2025-10-29 new -> 2025-11-25 first reopening -> 2025-12-23 second reopening and repeated every quarter back through 2023 (fiscaldata auctions_query, floating_rate:Yes, n=44 since 2023, pulled this session). SIZE EXPECTATION $28B: sb0590's anticipated-size table alternates its FRN column 30 in the new-issue months and 28 in the reopening months (Jul-26 30, Aug-26 28, Sep-26 28, Oct-26 30), and the tape agrees independently with 28 at every reopening since 2024-05-29. THE DATA TRAP THAT HIDES THIS SECURITY, inherited from the treasury-2y-frn-2026-10-28 ledger and independently reproduced here: fiscaldata's `security_term` reads `2-Year` only on FRN new issues; reopenings are tagged by REMAINING term — `1-Year 11-Month` for a first reopening and `1-Year 10-Month` for a second — so filtering on `2-Year` silently drops every reopening, and 2026-11-24 will file as `1-Year 11-Month`. SETTLEMENT IS THE UNUSUAL PART: Friday, November 27, 2026, the day after Thanksgiving and a SIFMA-recommended bond early close, alongside the four bill legs of the same announcement — while the three NOTE legs of that announcement settle Monday, November 30. DELIBERATELY REGISTERS NOTHING OF ITS OWN: the FRN discount-margin model FT-treasury-2y-frn-2026-10-28-1 and the FOMC-concession test FT-treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-10-22-2 already own that ground and score before this date; this proposal exists to give the auction a calendar row, not to re-litigate a measured question. Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
